PlannedType Annotation fhir=Annotation kind=complex-type
  embeds Element
  field AuthorReference *Reference json=authorReference optional=true
  field AuthorString *FHIRString json=authorString optional=true
  field Time *string json=time optional=true primitive
  field TimeElement *fhir.PrimitiveElement json=_time optional=true sibling-of=Time
  field Text *string json=text optional=true primitive
  field TextElement *fhir.PrimitiveElement json=_text optional=true sibling-of=Text
  choice author iface=AnnotationAuthor getter=Author
    branch AuthorReference json=authorReference setter=SetAuthorReference type=Reference primitive=false
    branch AuthorString json=authorString setter=SetAuthorString type=FHIRString primitive=true
